findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: google_serp, bing_serp, page_audit, news_search, image_search · Private data: domain_technologies · Public sink: free_sample, news_search · Destructive: retry_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: google_serp, bing_serp, page_audit, news_search, image_search · Private data: domain_technologies · Public sink: free_sample, news_search · Destructive: retry_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
